# No error handling for malformed JSON or file read

If the mutation scores file contains malformed JSON or is unreadable despite the file existing, the function will raise an exception instead of gracefully handling the error.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/mutation.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.mutation.read_mutation_scores`
